ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the clock to instantiated submodules; it sequences their synchronous processes by connecting to each instance clk_i port.
ports.evidence: clk_i connected in many port maps (e.g. frontend, control, alu, lsu) via port map lines.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides active-low reset to instantiated submodules; it is forwarded into each instance rstn_i port to initialize/reset their state.
ports.evidence: rstn_i connected in many port maps (e.g. frontend, control, alu, lsu) via port map lines.

ports.name: msi_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the machine-software interrupt bit to this entity; it is combined with mei_i and mti_i to form irq_machine used by control.

ports.name: mei_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the machine-external interrupt bit to this entity; it is combined with msi_i and mti_i to form irq_machine used by control.

ports.name: mti_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the machine-timer interrupt bit to this entity; it is combined with mei_i and msi_i to form irq_machine used by control.

ports.name: firq_i
ports.functionality: Forwards the fast interrupt vector to the control submodule; it is passed unchanged to the control instance's irq_fast_i port.
ports.evidence: port map in neorv32_cpu_control_inst: irq_fast_i => firq_i.

ports.name: dbi_i
ports.functionality: Forwards the debug interrupt input to the control instance; it is connected to the control's irq_dbg_i port.
ports.evidence: port map in neorv32_cpu_control_inst: irq_dbg_i => dbi_i.

ports.name: icc_tx_o
ports.functionality: Exposes the ICC transmit record to the outside; the record is sourced from the ICC instance when enabled or driven to a constant when ICC is disabled.
ports.evidence: icc instance port map: icc_tx_o => icc_tx_o; in disabled generate: icc_tx_o <= icc_terminate_c.

ports.name: icc_tx_o.rdy
ports.functionality: Outputs the ICC ready flag to the outside; the bit is forwarded from the ICC instance when present otherwise assigned in disabled generate.
ports.evidence: port map in icc instance: icc_tx_o => icc_tx_o; assignment in icc_disabled generate.

ports.name: icc_tx_o.ack
ports.functionality: Outputs the ICC acknowledge flag to external world; the bit is provided by the ICC instance via the port map when enabled.
ports.evidence: icc instance port map: icc_tx_o => icc_tx_o.

ports.name: icc_tx_o.dat
ports.functionality: Outputs the ICC data word to external connection; the vector is forwarded from the ICC instance when enabled or set in disabled generate.
ports.evidence: icc instance port map: icc_tx_o => icc_tx_o; icc_disabled assignment sets icc_tx_o.

ports.name: icc_rx_i
ports.functionality: Accepts the external ICC receive record; it is passed into the ICC instance's icc_rx_i port for consumption.
ports.evidence: icc instance port map: icc_rx_i => icc_rx_i.

ports.name: icc_rx_i.rdy
ports.functionality: Receives the ICC ready flag from outside and supplies it to the ICC instance's icc_rx_i port.
ports.evidence: icc instance port map: icc_rx_i => icc_rx_i.

ports.name: icc_rx_i.ack
ports.functionality: Receives the ICC acknowledge input and forwards it into the ICC instance via its icc_rx_i port.
ports.evidence: icc instance port map: icc_rx_i => icc_rx_i.

ports.name: icc_rx_i.dat
ports.functionality: Receives the ICC data word and feeds it into the ICC instance through its icc_rx_i port.
ports.evidence: icc instance port map: icc_rx_i => icc_rx_i.

ports.name: ibus_req_o
ports.functionality: Exports the instruction-bus request record to the system; it is driven by the frontend instance's ibus_req_o port.
ports.evidence: port map in frontend: ibus_req_o => ibus_req_o.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: Outputs the instruction bus address field; the field is carried from the frontend instance's ibus_req_o.addr through the entity boundary.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.data
ports.functionality: Outputs the instruction bus data field when applicable; forwarded from the frontend instance's request record.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.ben
ports.functionality: Outputs the instruction bus byte-enable field from the frontend instance to the external bus.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.stb
ports.functionality: Outputs a strobe signal for the instruction bus requests; forwarded from the frontend instance's request port.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.rw
ports.functionality: Outputs the read/write indication for instruction bus accesses; the bit is carried from the frontend instance.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.src
ports.functionality: Outputs the 'src' field of the instruction bus request as provided by the frontend instance.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.priv
ports.functionality: Outputs the privilege indicator for instruction bus requests; forwarded unchanged from the frontend instance.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.debug
ports.functionality: Outputs instruction bus debug indicator; forwarded from the frontend instance's request record.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.amo
ports.functionality: Outputs AMO flag for instruction-side atomic operations, forwarded from the frontend instance request record.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.amoop
ports.functionality: Outputs the AMO operation code field from the frontend request record to external bus.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.lock
ports.functionality: Outputs the lock indicator for instruction bus access; carried from the frontend instance.

ports.name: ibus_req_o.fence
ports.functionality: Outputs the fence indicator for instruction requests, forwarded from the frontend instance's request record.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Receives the instruction-bus response record from external bus and supplies it to the frontend instance via its ibus_rsp_i port.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Receives ack for instruction-bus responses and forwards it into the frontend instance's response port.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i.err
ports.functionality: Receives error indication for instruction-bus responses and forwards it to the frontend instance for handling.

ports.name: ibus_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: Receives response data from the instruction bus and forwards the 32-bit data field to the frontend instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o
ports.functionality: Exports the data-bus request record to the system; this record is driven by the LSU instance's dbus_req_o port.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: Outputs the address field for data-bus requests as provided by the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.data
ports.functionality: Outputs the data payload for data-bus requests; field is carried from the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.ben
ports.functionality: Outputs the byte-enable field for data-bus accesses; forwarded unchanged from the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.stb
ports.functionality: Outputs the strobe for data-bus requests, forwarded from the LSU instance's request record.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.rw
ports.functionality: Outputs read/write indicator for the data-bus request, forwarded from the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.src
ports.functionality: Outputs the source field of data-bus requests as provided by the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.priv
ports.functionality: Outputs the privilege indicator for data-bus accesses; forwarded from the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.debug
ports.functionality: Outputs debug indicator for data-bus requests, forwarded from the LSU instance's request record.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.amo
ports.functionality: Outputs AMO indicator for data-bus accesses; forwarded from the LSU instance's request record.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.amoop
ports.functionality: Outputs the AMO operation code field for data-bus requests; carried from the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.lock
ports.functionality: Outputs the lock indicator for data-bus requests and forwards the field from the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_req_o.fence
ports.functionality: Outputs fence indicator for data-bus operations; the field is carried from the LSU instance's request record.

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Receives the data-bus response record from outside and forwards it into the LSU instance's dbus_rsp_i port for consumption.

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Receives the ack bit of data-bus responses and forwards it into the LSU instance's response port.

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i.err
ports.functionality: Receives the error flag for data-bus responses and forwards it into the LSU instance.

ports.name: dbus_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: Receives 32-bit response data from the data bus and forwards it to the LSU instance for use.

signals.name: xcsr_cnt
signals.functionality: Holds CSR data from the counters unit; driven by the counters instance rdata_o and forwarded into the aggregate xcsr_res.
signals.evidence: counters port map: rdata_o => xcsr_cnt; xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc.

signals.name: xcsr_pmp
signals.functionality: Carries CSR data from the PMP unit into the xcsr_res aggregate; it is produced by the PMP instance when enabled or set to zero when PMP is disabled.
signals.evidence: pmp port map: csr_o => xcsr_pmp; xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc; pmp_disabled assigns xcsr_pmp <= (others => '0').

signals.name: xcsr_alu
signals.functionality: Receives CSR-related output from the ALU instance and contributes that value to the combined xcsr_res register read data.
signals.evidence: alu port map: csr_o => xcsr_alu; xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc.

signals.name: xcsr_res
signals.functionality: Combines CSR fragments (counter, ALU, PMP, ICC) by OR and supplies the result to the control unit's xcsr_rdata_i input.
signals.evidence: xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc; control port map: xcsr_rdata_i => xcsr_res.

signals.name: xcsr_icc
signals.functionality: Receives CSR read data from the ICC instance and supplies it into the combined xcsr_res value.
signals.evidence: icc port map: csr_rdata_o => xcsr_icc; xcsr_res <= xcsr_cnt or xcsr_alu or xcsr_pmp or xcsr_icc.

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Carries the control/control-status bus produced by the control instance and forwards its fields to frontend, regfile, ALU, LSU, PMP, counters and ICC where consumed.
signals.evidence: control port map: ctrl_o => ctrl; many instances map ctrl_i => ctrl; icc maps specific ctrl fields.

signals.name: ctrl.if_fence
signals.functionality: Forwards the instruction-fetch fence control bit from the control instance through the ctrl bus into the frontend instance for consumption.
signals.evidence: ctrl is driven by control.ctrl_o and passed into frontend via ctrl_i => ctrl (port maps).

signals.name: ctrl.if_reset
signals.functionality: Forwards the frontend reset control bit from control instance within the ctrl record to the frontend instance.
signals.evidence: ctrl passed to frontend via port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.if_ack
signals.functionality: Forwards the frontend ack control bit from the control instance to the frontend module via the ctrl bus.
signals.evidence: ctrl passed to frontend via port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.pc_cur
signals.functionality: Carries the current PC field from control to frontend and other consumers via the ctrl record; forwarded unchanged from control instance.
signals.evidence: ctrl record passed to frontend and other modules via port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.pc_nxt
signals.functionality: Carries the next-PC field from the control instance inside the ctrl record and forwards it to consumers via ctrl_i mappings.
signals.evidence: ctrl passed into frontend via port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.pc_ret
signals.functionality: Provides the PC return value produced by control; it is used in the rf_wdata selection expression to become a writeback source for the register file.
signals.evidence: rf_wdata <= alu_res or lsu_rdata or csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret; ctrl passed to frontend via ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.rf_wb_en
signals.functionality: Carries the register-file write-enable control bit from control instance inside ctrl and is consumed by the regfile via its ctrl_i input.
signals.evidence: regfile port map: ctrl_i => ctrl (control fields read by regfile).

signals.name: ctrl.rf_rs1
signals.functionality: Forwards the rs1 index field from the control instance through the ctrl bus into the regfile, which consumes it to select a register.
signals.evidence: regfile port map: ctrl_i => ctrl and regfile reads ctrl.rf_rs1 internally.

signals.name: ctrl.rf_rs2
signals.functionality: Forwards the rs2 index field from the control instance to the regfile via the ctrl record for operand selection.
signals.evidence: regfile port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.rf_rd
signals.functionality: Carries the destination register index from the control instance inside ctrl and supplies it to the regfile through ctrl_i for writes.
signals.evidence: regfile port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.rf_zero_we
signals.functionality: Forwards the control bit that inhibits writes to x0 from the control instance to the regfile via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: regfile port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_op
signals.functionality: Carries the ALU operation code field from the control instance inside ctrl and forwards it to the ALU instance via its ctrl_i input.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_sub
signals.functionality: Forwards the ALU subtract control bit from the control instance to the ALU via the ctrl bus.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_opa_mux
signals.functionality: Carries the operand-A multiplexer control from control to the ALU instance inside the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_opb_mux
signals.functionality: Forwards the operand-B multiplexer control from the control instance to the ALU via ctrl.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_unsigned
signals.functionality: Forwards the ALU unsigned arithmetic flag from control to the ALU instance via the ctrl record for signed/unsigned decisions.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_imm
signals.functionality: Carries the immediate operand field from control inside ctrl and supplies it to the ALU instance for operations using immediates.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_cp_alu
signals.functionality: Forwards the ALU coprocessor select bit (ALU path) from control to the ALU instance within the ctrl bus.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_cp_cfu
signals.functionality: Forwards the CFU coprocessor selection bit from control to ALU/CFU-consumers via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.alu_cp_fpu
signals.functionality: Forwards the FPU coprocessor select bit from control inside the ctrl record to ALU/FPU consumers.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_req
signals.functionality: Carries the LSU request enable/control bit from control to the LSU instance via ctrl for initiating memory operations.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_rw
signals.functionality: Forwards the read/write control bit for the LSU from control to the LSU instance via ctrl.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_amo
signals.functionality: Carries the atomic operation flag from control to the LSU instance via ctrl for atomic memory ops.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_mo_we
signals.functionality: Forwards memory-order write-enable control from the control unit into the LSU via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_fence
signals.functionality: Forwards fence control for memory ops from control to the LSU instance via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.lsu_priv
signals.functionality: Carries the privilege level field from control into the LSU instance via the ctrl record to qualify memory accesses.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.csr_we
signals.functionality: Carries CSR write-enable from the control instance and is delivered to the ICC instance's csr_we_i port (and other CSR consumers) to control CSR writes.
role: forwarded to ICC and CSR consumers
signals.evidence: icc port map: csr_we_i => ctrl.csr_we; ctrl is driven by control.ctrl_o.

signals.name: ctrl.csr_re
signals.functionality: Carries the CSR read-enable bit from control and supplies it to the ICC instance's csr_re_i port when ICC exists.
signals.evidence: icc port map: csr_re_i => ctrl.csr_re.

signals.name: ctrl.csr_addr
signals.functionality: Carries the CSR address field from control and supplies it to ICC (csr_addr_i) and other CSR consumers via ctrl.
signals.evidence: icc port map: csr_addr_i => ctrl.csr_addr.

signals.name: ctrl.csr_wdata
signals.functionality: Carries CSR write-data from control and forwards it into the ICC instance's csr_wdata_i port for CSR writes.
signals.evidence: icc port map: csr_wdata_i => ctrl.csr_wdata.

signals.name: ctrl.cnt_halt
signals.functionality: Carries counter halt mask field from control via the ctrl record to the counters instance when present.
signals.evidence: counters port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.cnt_event
signals.functionality: Carries the event selector for counters from control and forwards it to the counters instance via the ctrl bus.
signals.evidence: counters port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.ir_funct3
signals.functionality: Carries the decoded funct3 field from control inside the ctrl record and forwards it to ALU/other consumers via ctrl.
signals.evidence: ctrl passed to ALU via ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.ir_funct12
signals.functionality: Forwards the decoded funct12 immediate field from control to consumers via the ctrl bus.
signals.evidence: alu port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.ir_opcode
signals.functionality: Carries the decoded opcode field from control inside the ctrl record and forwards it to frontend/ALU as needed.
signals.evidence: ctrl passed to frontend and ALU via ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_priv
signals.functionality: Carries the CPU privilege level field from control and forwards it to LSU/PMP/other consumers that require privilege info via ctrl.
signals.evidence: ctrl passed into LSU and PMP via ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_sleep
signals.functionality: Forwards the CPU sleep control flag from control to any consumer that reads it via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: ctrl produced by control.ctrl_o and distributed via ctrl_i mappings.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_trap
signals.functionality: Carries the trap indicator from the control instance inside the ctrl record and is available to other modules via ctrl.
signals.evidence: ctrl passed to frontend/regfile via port maps.

signals.name: ctrl.cpu_debug
signals.functionality: Carries the debug-mode indicator from the control instance and forwards it to modules (frontend, regfile, etc.) via the ctrl record.
signals.evidence: ctrl passed to frontend/regfile via port map: ctrl_i => ctrl.

signals.name: frontend
signals.functionality: Carries the fetch-stage outputs (valid, instr, compr, fault, halted) from the frontend instance into this entity and supplies them to the control instance.
signals.evidence: frontend port map: frontend_o => frontend; control port map: frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: frontend.valid
signals.functionality: Provides the valid flag from the frontend instance and forwards it to the control instance where it is consumed via frontend input.
signals.evidence: frontend port map and control port map: frontend_o => frontend; frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: frontend.instr
signals.functionality: Carries the fetched 32-bit instruction from the frontend instance and forwards it to the control unit via the frontend record.
signals.evidence: frontend port map and control port map: frontend_o => frontend; frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: frontend.compr
signals.functionality: Carries the compression indicator from the frontend instance and forwards it to control via the frontend record.
signals.evidence: frontend port map and control port map: frontend_o => frontend; frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: frontend.fault
signals.functionality: Carries the fetch fault indicator from the frontend instance into the control instance via the frontend bundle.
signals.evidence: frontend port map and control port map: frontend_o => frontend; frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: frontend.halted
signals.functionality: Carries the frontend halted indication from the frontend instance and forwards it to the control instance via the frontend record.
signals.evidence: frontend port map and control port map: frontend_o => frontend; frontend_i => frontend.

signals.name: rf_wdata
signals.functionality: Selects writeback data for the register file by OR'ing several sources (ALU result, LSU read data, CSR read data, or control.pc_ret) and supplies the result to the regfile rd_i port.
signals.evidence: rf_wdata <= alu_res or lsu_rdata or csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret; regfile port map: rd_i => rf_wdata.

signals.name: rs1
signals.functionality: Receives rs1 data from the regfile instance and supplies it to the ALU and control instances as an operand or reference.
signals.evidence: regfile port map: rs1_o => rs1; alu port map: rs1_i => rs1; control port map: rf_rs1_i => rs1.

signals.name: rs2
signals.functionality: Receives rs2 data from the regfile instance and supplies it to the ALU and LSU (as write data) via instance port connections.
signals.evidence: regfile rs2_o => rs2; alu rs2_i => rs2; lsu wdata_i => rs2.

signals.name: rs3
signals.functionality: Carries rs3 data produced by the regfile and supplies it to the ALU instance (for three-operand ops) via port mapping.
signals.evidence: regfile port map: rs3_o => rs3; alu port map: rs3_i => rs3.

signals.name: alu_res
signals.functionality: Receives the ALU result from the ALU instance and is one of the sources selected into the register-file writeback data (rf_wdata).
signals.evidence: alu port map: res_o => alu_res; rf_wdata <= alu_res or lsu_rdata or csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret.

signals.name: alu_add
signals.functionality: Carries the ALU adder output from the ALU instance and supplies that computed address/value to the LSU and to the control instance (alu_add_i).
role: forwarded from ALU to LSU and control
signals.evidence: alu port map: add_o => alu_add; lsu port map: addr_i => alu_add; control port map: alu_add_i => alu_add.

signals.name: alu_cmp
signals.functionality: Carries the ALU compare result (two-bit) from the ALU instance and supplies it to the control unit where branch decisions are made.
signals.evidence: alu port map: cmp_o => alu_cmp; control port map: alu_cmp_i => alu_cmp.

signals.name: lsu_rdata
signals.functionality: Carries read data produced by the LSU instance and is one of the inputs selected into rf_wdata for register writeback.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: rdata_o => lsu_rdata; rf_wdata <= alu_res or lsu_rdata or csr_rdata or ctrl.pc_ret.

signals.name: alu_cp_done
signals.functionality: Receives the ALU coprocessor done/complete flag from the ALU instance and forwards it to the control unit (alu_cp_done_i) for sequencing control.
signals.evidence: alu port map: done_o => alu_cp_done; control port map: alu_cp_done_i => alu_cp_done.

signals.name: lsu_wait
signals.functionality: Carries the LSU wait indicator from the LSU instance and supplies it to the control unit via lsu_wait_i for stall handling.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: wait_o => lsu_wait; control port map: lsu_wait_i => lsu_wait.

signals.name: csr_rdata
signals.functionality: Holds CSR read data produced by the control instance and supplies it as a possible register-file writeback source (rf_wdata).
signals.evidence: control port map: csr_rdata_o => csr_rdata; rf_wdata <= ... or csr_rdata ...

signals.name: lsu_mar
signals.functionality: Receives the memory address register output from the LSU instance and forwards it to the control unit (lsu_mar_i) for debug/exception handling.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: mar_o => lsu_mar; control port map: lsu_mar_i => lsu_mar.

signals.name: lsu_err
signals.functionality: Carries LSU error status bits from the LSU instance and supplies them to the control unit for exception reporting via lsu_err_i.
signals.evidence: lsu port map: err_o => lsu_err; control port map: lsu_err_i => lsu_err.

signals.name: pmp_fault
signals.functionality: Receives the PMP fault output when PMP is enabled (from PMP instance) or is held '0' when PMP is disabled; the signal is forwarded to the control unit to indicate access faults.
role: sourced from PMP instance or tied low
signals.evidence: pmp port map: fault_o => pmp_fault; pmp_disabled sets pmp_fault <= '0'; control port map: pmp_fault_i => pmp_fault.

signals.name: irq_machine
signals.functionality: Combines the three machine interrupt inputs (mti_i, mei_i, msi_i) into a 3-bit vector and supplies it to the control instance as the machine interrupt input.
signals.evidence: irq_machine <= mti_i & mei_i & msi_i; control port map: irq_machine_i => irq_machine.
